transcript: Bathe with rue, rosemary and basil, for three consecutive days, and the doors that were closed will open. This bath has been used for centuries to cleanse energy, open pathways, and ward off everything they want to cause you, whether through envy or malice. Here's how to prepare it. Boil a handful of rue, another of rosemary, and another of basil, in a large pot with water for ten minutes. Let it cool down, strain it, and take it to the bathroom. After showering, normally pour it over your body from head downward. While doing this, say silently, I cleanse what weighs heavy, I ward off what harms, I open the pathways that were closed, let it dry on your skin without rinsing. Rue is the protective plant par, excellence. It cuts through all types of negative energy, envy, evil eye, and anything they have sent you. Rosemary opens blocked pathways and activates prosperity, and basil attracts good luck and balances your energetic field. Together they create a complete cleansing, they protect, open and attract at the same time, do this for three consecutive nights. Many people notice that after the third bath, things start to move, opportunities that appear, stuck situations that get unblocked, people who drift away for no reason, as if what was blocking had dissolved. Keep this to yourself while you do it. What you protect in silence works with more strength. Write in the comments, my pathways are opening. If you're going to start tonight, but I want you to understand something, herbs cleanse what comes from outside, but if inside you keep carrying fear, stress and emotions you don't release, your own energy blocks you more than any envy. Rituals open doors, but what keeps them open is the inner work, and if you want to learn to protect yourself from within so that nothing from outside ever touches you again. I've been learning in silence for over 20 years how to do it, and everything I know is inside the path back to calm. The link is in my profile.
